scope: Analyze the MCP tool surface, AI integration, and clip-list UI/UX. Analysis, plus one applied fix (MCP JSON Schema dialect).

findings.title: Five of eight MCP tools are silently dropped by every client: schemas emit the draft-04 boolean form of exclusiveMinimum
findings.status: FIXED in source, NOT YET LIVE
findings.mechanism: OpenAPI 3.0 inherits draft-04 numeric keywords, so z.number().int().positive() serializes to {"type":"integer","exclusiveMinimum":true,"minimum":0}. MCP clients validate against draft-07+, where exclusiveMinimum must be a number, and drop a failing tool from the tool list with no user-visible error. Affected exactly the five tools taking a numeric id/clipID/categoryID/limit: clippy_search, clippy_list_recent, clippy_get, clippy_delete, clippy_set_category. The three with no numeric parameter survived.
findings.evidence: tools/list probe against build/index.mjs before the fix printed "exclusiveMinimum": true on all five; the session's own MCP connection report listed exactly those five as excluded with the message 'schema/properties/id/exclusiveMinimum must be number'.
findings.fix: target: "jsonSchema7". Rebuilt and synced to integrations/clippy-plugin/mcp/index.mjs.
findings.verification: npm test -> 'SCHEMA DIALECT: draft-07+ on all 8 tools' + 'ALL CHECKS PASSED'. Probe on both bundles: 'boolean exclusiveMinimum: 0'; clippy_get.id -> {"type":"integer","exclusiveMinimum":0}.
findings.guard: integrations/clippy-mcp/test/smoke.mjs now walks every advertised inputSchema and fails on any non-numeric exclusiveMinimum/exclusiveMaximum.

findings.title: The live MCP server is a third bundle copy inside Clippy.app that sync-mcp.sh does not update
findings.culprit: scripts/make-app.sh:62 bundles build/index.mjs into Clippy.app/Contents/Resources/clippy-mcp/index.mjs; integrations/scripts/sync-mcp.sh updates only build/ and the plugin copy.
findings.evidence: ~/.claude.json registers clippy as {"type":"http","url":"http://127.0.0.1:6015/mcp"}; lsof shows pid 948 = /Applications/Clippy.app/Contents/Resources/clippy-mcp/index.mjs holding 6015. shasum: installed b7360a50..., rebuilt 971736e4... (differ).
findings.consequence: F1's fix reaches users only on the next app build + install, and the MCP client must restart to renegotiate its tool list.

findings.title: MCP writes are invisible to the running app: GRDB ValueObservation does not observe external connections
findings.culprit: Sources/Clippy/UI/ClipStore.swift:78,109 (ValueObservation) vs integrations/clippy-mcp/src/db.ts (separate node:sqlite process on the same file).
findings.evidence: GRDB docs, ValueObservation.md 'Dealing with Undetected Changes': does not detect changes made through external database connections. DatabaseSharing.md: cross-process observation needs NSFileCoordinator or a Darwin notification.
findings.consequence: clippy_add inserts a row the running panel will not display until the next in-app write or an app restart. Same for category changes. Blocks 'manage my clips from Claude'.
findings.recommendation: Route MCP mutations through the app (it already runs McpServerController and a Unix-socket path from S3388) so there is one writer and observation works by construction. Fallback: keep direct writes, add a Darwin notification -> db.notifyChanges(in: .fullDatabase), and set PRAGMA busy_timeout (absent today in db.ts:openDatabase).

findings.title: Folder copies from Finder fail on every capture; 97% of the log is this one error
findings.mechanism: A directory reports a non-zero size attribute, passes the filter, then fails Data(contentsOf:) with NSPOSIXErrorDomain 21 'Is a directory'. The error is logged and swallowed: no clip, no capture sound, nothing surfaced in the UI.
findings.evidence: ~/Library/Application Support/Clippy/Logs/clippy.log: 1273 of 1313 lines (97%) are 'Failed to save file clip: unreadableFile', 2026-07-12 to 2026-09-02. Reproduced: swift probe on an empty directory prints 'size attr: 64' then 'read FAILED: ... Code=21 "Is a directory"'.
findings.recommendation: Check isDirectoryKey in the filter and store folders as a path reference (Clip.filePath already exists) rather than dropping them. Skip iCloud-evicted files via ubiquitousItemDownloadingStatus. Surface capture failures once instead of silently.

findings.title: Apple Intelligence is available on the target platform and unused
findings.evidence: swift probe: 'import FoundationModels; SystemLanguageModel.default.availability' -> available, on macOS 27.0 / Swift 6.4. Package floor is already .macOS(.v26). ctx_search for FoundationModels/SystemLanguageModel over Sources/ returns 0 matches. docs/ROADMAP.md lists it as deferred on a platform floor that is now in place.
findings.unverified: Whether LanguageModelSession tool-calling maps onto the existing AITool protocol (Sources/Clippy/AI/AIToolDefinition.swift:12). Confirm against the current SDK before writing the provider.

findings.title: Categories are effectively unused: 93% of clips are uncategorized
findings.evidence: sqlite3 clippy.sqlite: clips 644, categories 6, memberships 44, uncategorized 600, titled 43, images 6. Screenshot shows 2 of 6 categories at count 0.
findings.consequence: The app's primary organizing affordance carries 7% of the content. Filing is one clip at a time via a submenu; batch assignment exists nowhere, including MCP.

findings.title: Relative timestamps render 'in 0s' for freshly captured clips
findings.recommendation: Floor the interval; special-case under a minute to 'now'.

findings.title: iCloud sync fails on clipboard text containing control characters
findings.evidence: clippy.log, 16 occurrences: 'iCloud sync failed: Error while parsing string: unescaped control characters other than TAB (U+0009) are explicitly prohibited (at line 543, column 23)'. 23 successes against 16 failures.
